title: Minimum Rotations to Dial a Number II
statement: Given a digit string s of length up to 10^5 and a circular dial 0-9 whose pointer starts at 0, where each rotation moves one step either way, the task is to find the minimum total rotations needed to dial s in order. Before dialing, at most one suffix s[k..n-1] may be reversed, and the best choice of k (or no reversal) must be found.
